sourceFile: 83.BRS-161014 Report checking AWF machine and test process solder date 11.12.2023_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are too mixed for final evidence.
issues: Unrelated AWF machine, pad cleaning, tip, suspension, coil, and jig tests are merged into one factor.
Baseline and changed conditions are not supported as a single comparison.
Date, shift, machine, line, item, type, and repair-stage grouping keys are not preserved.
Some pair metrics appear taken from repair/NG-sample columns but are labeled as input or NG rate.
BRS-161016 pad clean section is mixed into the BRS-161014 report case without separation.
requiredUserQuestions: If only one final case is needed, should the focus be AWF machine, pad cleaning, or tip/process solder testing?
correctionPlan: Split review cases or changed factors by source table section and objective.
Preserve date, shift, AWF machine, line, item/type, and repair-stage keys in each outcome.
Define baseline/test only where rows show a valid intended comparison; otherwise keep as descriptive metrics.
Recalculate rates using the correct table headers for before repair, re-spot, and after repair fields.
Limit citations to relevant header and data rows for each rebuilt factor.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are overbroad and misassigned; sufficient only after regrouping.
